entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: For they that sleep sleep in the night: and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God appointed us not into wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: Rejoice always;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: pray without ceasing;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Quench not the Spirit;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: despise not prophesyings;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: abstain from every form of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brethren, pray for us.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
